The two controls are what make it readable and both are negative: a dilated ResNet fits BETTER in training and generalizes worse, and a plain U-Net at w96 is barely above the shipped w24 FNO -- so the gain is the spectral operator PLUS a local branch, not 'a conv net was better' and not 'more parameters'. Diluting hurts (1 U-FNO + 2 FNOs scores 81.296, much nearer the FNO). Staged as track{1,2}_r15_ufno3_a060.zip, predicted 81.33; NOT yet scored, which is why this is OPEN and not SHIPPED. BOARD-TESTED 2026-09-04 (T2R4, 914508): 80.879 against a predicted 81.33, a MISS OF -0.45 and the largest instrument residual on record. The board returned rel_l2 +1.90 % of error WORSE against the anchor where this 3-vs-3 said -4.4 %, and sps +0.44 against +0.95 -- a 4.0-pp residual on rel_l2 alone; ensemble size (3 against 8) explains at most ~1 pp. Latency was the other half, 8.69 board ms against 4.78, because 5.457 ms/step was the real cost (the staging README's 1.28 was wrong) and allow_tf32=False makes the 3x3 convs ~50 % slower. At the anchor's latency the package is +0.07. WORKING HYPOTHESIS: the local U-Net branch memorizes in distribution -- the held-out trajectories share Reynolds numbers with training, the hidden set does not. The interior Re-band k-fold, the one instrument that called the w96 package's shape, was never run on U-FNO; Q3 runs it, and every non-FNO family is gated on it.
note_zh: 自第 8 轮以来第一个越过 board ~4 % 迁移分辨率的实验——dropout 在它最好的仪器上是 -2.6 %，拿下 81.019 的 w96x8 包是 -1.2 %。它还同时改善了四个被计分的误差指标，这在本项目里只有 --lam-grad 做到过。两个对照让结论可读，而且都是负的：dilated ResNet 训练拟合更好、泛化更差；纯 U-Net（w96）只比现役 w24 FNO 高一点——所以收益来自谱算子“加上”局部分支，既不是“卷积网更好”，也不是“参数更多”。稀释会掉分（1 个 U-FNO + 2 个 FNO 只有 81.296，更靠近 FNO）。已打包为 track{1,2}_r15_ufno3_a060.zip，预测 81.33；尚未评分，所以状态是 OPEN 而不是 SHIPPED。（2026-09-04 board 检验，T2R4，914508）：实得 80.879，预测 81.33，差 -0.45，是本项目记录中最大的一次仪器残差。board 上 rel_l2 相对 anchor 反而变差 +1.90 %，而这次 3-vs-3 说的是 -4.4 %；sps 只有 +0.44，预测 +0.95——单是 rel_l2 就有 4.0 个百分点的残差，集成规模（3 对 8）最多解释 ~1 个百分点。延迟是另一半：board 8.69 ms 对 4.78 ms，因为真实开销是 5.457 ms/step（staging README 写的 1.28 是错的），而且 allow_tf32=False 让 3x3 卷积慢约 50 %。若在 anchor 的延迟下，这个包是 +0.07。工作假设：局部 U-Net 分支在分布内记忆——held-out 轨迹与训练共享 Reynolds 数，隐藏测试集不共享。唯一说对了 w96 包形状的仪器（interior Re-band k-fold）从未在 U-FNO 上跑过；Q3 会跑，所有非 FNO 家族都以它为闸。

arm_zh: AFNO（在保留模上做块对角 MLP + 软阈值）

effect_zh: 0.24M 参数——只有现役模型的四分之一——仍拿到 82.168 / 84.337，高于 14.24M 的 w96 FNO；训练 field 0.0785（是别人的两倍），seen/unseen 差距 1.05x
note: The most interesting negative-space result of the round: the only arm that genuinely underfits and the only one with essentially NO generalization gap. Sharing spectral weights across modes and soft-thresholding is a real regularizer, and the parameter budget is demonstrably not what buys the score. Not a package candidate as built -- but it is the third leg of the cross-family trio, which is the best set measured this round.
note_zh: 本轮最有意思的反面结果：唯一真正欠拟合的实验，也是唯一几乎没有泛化差距的实验。跨模共享谱权重加软阈值是真正的正则化，而参数预算显然不是买到分数的东西。按现在的形态不是打包候选——但它是跨家族三元组的第三条腿，而那是本轮测到的最好组合。

arm: Dilated ResNet (4 blocks x 7 dilated 3x3, dilations 1-2-4-8-4-2-1)
arm_zh: Dilated ResNet（4 个 block x 7 个空洞 3x3，膨胀率 1-2-4-8-4-2-1）
instrument: 1 seed, AoA 15-20 proxy + full split
instrument_zh: 1 个种子，AoA 15-20 proxy + 全划分
effect: 81.980 / 84.235, below every FNO here, with the round's SECOND-LOWEST training field (0.0299) and held-out rho 0.600
effect_zh: 81.980 / 84.235，低于这里所有 FNO，而训练 field 是本轮第二低（0.0299），留出 rho 0.600
note: A deliberate control, and its failure is the load-bearing one: it reaches the whole grid in one block with a purely local, translation-equivariant parameterization and NO mode truncation, it fits the training set better than the FNO, and it generalizes worse. So the Fourier parameterization is doing real work -- it is not merely a cheap global receptive field, and U-FNO's win is not 'a conv net was better'.
note_zh: 这是特意设置的对照，而它的失败正是承重的那一块：它用纯局部、平移等变、且没有模截断的参数化在一个 block 内覆盖整个网格，训练拟合比 FNO 更好，泛化却更差。所以傅里叶参数化确实在做实事——它不只是一个便宜的全局感受野，U-FNO 的胜出也不是“卷积网更好”。

arm_zh: 跨家族三元组：U-FNO + ViT + AFNO，各一个种子

But diluting with FNOs loses -- swapping AFNO for a w96 FNO drops sps to 44.70, and adding three FNOs to the trio makes it WORSE than the trio (44.63). The FNO is now the weakest family in the set. instrument_zh: kfold.py --split re --bands 1 2 3，w96 do30 对第 13 轮的 w24 do15 折，在 2152 个窗口 / 52 条轨迹上配对

arm: latency and fusion for a mixed package (lat_r15.py)
arm_zh: 混合包的延迟与融合（lat_r15.py）
instrument: end-to-end replication of predict()'s timed section, idle node, median of 5; validate_strict agrees to 2 %
instrument_zh: 端到端复现 predict() 被计时的部分，空闲节点，5 次取中位；与 validate_strict 相差 2 %
effect: 8 fused w96 cost +0.93 board ms = -0.063 final vs 8 w24 (BOARD later charged +1.41 ms); 3x w96 = the same board ms as 8x w24; an INVOCATION costs 0.435 ms, so 8xw24+4xw96 (-0.083) loses to 8xw96; 4x L8 in one invocation is +0.009 vs the board package
effect_zh: 8 个融合的 w96 是 +0.93 board ms = -0.063 final（board 后来实收 +1.41 ms）；3x w96 与 8x w24 的 board ms 相同；一次调用值 0.435 ms，所以 8xw24+4xw96（-0.083）输给 8xw96；4x L8 单次调用相对 board 上的包是 +0.009
note: The package is LAUNCH-BOUND, not FLOP-bound: 16x the width costs 14 % more A100 time at one member. So capacity is cheap and INVOCATIONS are not -- and _fno.fuse folds FNO2d members ONLY, so N U-FNO members are N invocations. A StackedUFNO is worth +0.09..0.13 final at 3-4 members and is pure engineering; it is the first item of round 16. Caveat recorded: the model under-predicted the real board cost of eight fused w96 members by 50 %.
note_zh: 这个包是受 kernel 启动约束，而不是受 FLOP 约束：单成员下宽度放大 16 倍只多花 14 % 的 A100 时间。所以容量便宜、调用次数不便宜——而且 _fno.fuse 只折叠 FNO2d 成员，于是 N 个 U-FNO 成员就是 N 次调用。写一个 StackedUFNO 在 3-4 个成员时值 +0.09..0.13 final，纯工程，是第 16 轮的第一项。已记下的告诫：这个模型把 8 个融合 w96 成员的真实 board 代价低估了 50 %。

arm: int8 spectral packing / low-rank factorization (the byte budget)
arm_zh: 谱权重 int8 打包 / 低秩分解（字节预算）
instrument: weight perturbation on the three held-out w96 twins, scored through the official scoring.py
instrument_zh: 在三个留出的 w96 孪生模型上做权重扰动，用官方 scoring.py 打分
effect: int8 (one scale per OUTPUT channel per tensor): 28.5 -> 14.3 MB/member for -0.02 % rel-L2, -0.05 % TKE, -0.02 % MVPE; low-rank r=48 keeps 69.6 % of the energy and multiplies rel-L2 by 2.9 (0.0776 -> 0.2216), r=24 by 3.4
effect_zh: int8（每个张量、每个输出通道一个 scale）：28.5 -> 14.3 MB/成员，代价是 rel-L2 -0.02 %、TKE -0.05 %、MVPE -0.02 %；低秩 r=48 保留 69.6 % 能量却把 rel-L2 乘以 2.9（0.0776 -> 0.2216），r=24 乘以 3.4
note: AN FNO IS ITS SPECTRAL WEIGHTS AND NOTHING ELSE -- 99.4 % of a w96 member, and 4*width^2*modes_y*modes_x*n_layers exactly. int8 is FREE and is the single most useful engineering result of the round: it takes 8 x w96 from 228.6 MB to 114.7 and makes EIGHT L8 members fit where four did. Measured as a perturbation only; storing real int8 + scales in the blob and de-quantizing in _fno.load_any is small and unwritten. Low-rank fails decisively: the operator is genuinely mode-specific, there is no small shared set of channel-mixing matrices modulated across wavenumber. That does NOT contradict AFNO at 0.24M -- AFNO TRAINS under the constraint and finds another solution; projecting a trained FNO onto it does not work. Rank 96 is exact, which confirms the harness.
note_zh: FNO 就是它的谱权重，别无其他——占 w96 成员的 99.4 %，且严格等于 4*width^2*modes_y*modes_x*n_layers。int8 是免费的，也是本轮最有用的工程结果：把 8 x w96 从 228.6 MB 降到 114.7，让原本只能放 4 个的 L8 成员放得下 8 个。目前只作为权重扰动测过；把真正的 int8 + scale 存进 blob、在 _fno.load_any 里反量化，是一处很小但尚未写的改动。低秩则彻底失败：这个算子确实是逐模的，不存在一小组共享的通道混合矩阵沿波数被调制。这与 AFNO 在 0.24M 下表现好并不矛盾——AFNO 是在该约束下训练并找到了另一个解；把已训好的 FNO 投影上去不行。秩 96 是精确的，验证了这套测量。

arm: TF32 makes the output depend on BATCH POSITION
arm_zh: TF32 让输出依赖样本在 batch 中的位置
instrument: verify/cpu_smoke_submission.py permutation invariance vs validate_strict.py, TF32 on and off
instrument_zh: verify/cpu_smoke_submission.py 的置换不变性 对 validate_strict.py，TF32 开与关
effect: U-FNO x3 permute: 1.80e-04 with TF32 on, 8.64e-07 off, and 0.00e+00 on a repeat; w96 FNO x3: 9.10e-06 on, 5.07e-07 off. The first ufno3 build FAILED the 1e-4 bound
effect_zh: U-FNO x3 置换：TF32 开为 1.80e-04，关为 8.64e-07，重复运行为 0.00e+00；w96 FNO x3：开 9.10e-06，关 5.07e-07。第一次 ufno3 构建没过 1e-4 的界
note: REPEATS ARE BIT-EXACT, so this is NOT nondeterminism: TF32 tiles a GEMM/convolution across the BATCH axis, so a window's position in the batch decides its accumulation order and a 10-bit mantissa makes that visible. The U-FNO's 3x3 convolutions carry ~20x more of it than the FNO's 1x1 + FFT path, which is why every previous package passed. allow_tf32 = False now ships in BOTH tracks; it is free (round 11: +0.05 ms, no subscore change past 1e-5) and removes a real dependence of our score on the evaluator's batching order. METHOD RULE: run both gates -- validate_strict measures order-dependence as a RELATIVE drift of the mean field and passed this at 1.1e-05; cpu_smoke measures max|diff| absolutely and failed it.
note_zh: 重复运行是逐位一致的，所以这不是不确定性：TF32 沿 batch 轴对 GEMM/卷积分块，于是一个窗口在 batch 中的位置决定了它的累加顺序，而 10 位尾数让这一点可见。U-FNO 的 3x3 卷积承载的这类误差约为 FNO 的 1x1 + FFT 路径的 20 倍，这就是之前每个包都通过的原因。allow_tf32 = False 现在在两个赛道都随包发布；它是免费的（第 11 轮：+0.05 ms，子分数变化不超过 1e-5），并且消除了我们的分数对评测端 batch 顺序的真实依赖。方法规则：两道闸都要跑——validate_strict 把顺序依赖当作平均场的相对漂移来量，在 1.1e-05 上放行；cpu_smoke 量的是绝对 max|diff|，把它拦下了。

arm: the seed floor at width 96 / dropout 0.45 (three twins of the control)
arm_zh: 宽度 96 / dropout 0.45 处的种子噪声底（对照的三个孪生）
instrument: compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39, three seeds of one recipe, AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split
instrument_zh: compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，同一配方的三个种子，AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分
effect: sps 43.79 / 43.79 / 43.79 on the proxy and 50.04 / 50.05 / 50.09 on the full split: a range of 0.00 and 0.05. proxy wfinal 82.188 / 82.193 / 82.196, sigma ~ 0.008; training field 0.04746 / 0.04777 / 0.04760
note: THIS IS WHAT MAKES A ONE-SEED ARM READABLE, and it is 2x tighter than round 11's 0.017 wfinal sigma at width 24. Capacity plus heavy dropout does not just regularize the model, it regularizes the SEED: three different initializations and three different batch orders land on the same sps to two decimals. Every Q2 verdict this round is a comparison against a bit-matched control (same --seed, so the same init and the same batch order), and the floor measured here is what says a +0.36 sps margin is a result and a -0.03 one is not. It does NOT license reading margins below ~0.05 sps, and it says nothing about the board's ~4 % transfer resolution, which is a different and much larger number.
note_zh: 正是它让单种子的实验臂可读，而且比第 11 轮宽度 24 下的 0.017 wfinal sigma 还紧一倍。容量加重 dropout 不只是正则化了模型，也正则化了种子：三种不同初始化、三种不同批次顺序，落到同一个 sps，小数点后两位都一样。本轮每个 Q2 判定都是与逐位匹配的对照相比（同一 --seed，因而同一初始化与同一批次顺序），而这里量到的底噪，正是判定 +0.36 sps 的差距算结果、-0.03 不算的依据。它不允许解读小于约 0.05 sps 的差距，也完全没有涉及 board 约 4 % 的迁移分辨率——那是另一个大得多的数。

arm_zh: --wd 0.05（容量下的 AdamW 解耦权重衰减）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_cap_w96_do45_e400; compare_v9 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_cap_w96_do45_e400 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9
effect: sps 43.72 vs 43.79 proxy and 50.01 vs 50.04 full (LOSES on both); rel-L2 0.1068 / 0.0793, TKE 0.5066 / 0.5184, MVPE 0.0976 / 0.0713, all worse than the control; training field 0.04721 vs 0.04746, i.e. it fits BETTER

note_zh: 正好撞上淘汰规则的第二条：拟合更好，泛化没有更好。1e-5 这个默认值被硬编码了十二轮、从未扫过，所以这条轴值得一个实验臂——但在 --dropout 0.45 已经把 45 % 的通道置零之后，模型并不处在“缩小权重能买到东西”的区间，而 0.05 又温和到主要只是改变了有效学习率。在这个工作点上，--wd 这条轴关闭。

arm_zh: --mode-drop 0.2（对保留的 Fourier 模做 DropConnect）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched control; compare_v9 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; p = 0 verified bit-identical to the pre-edit forward
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，逐位匹配的对照；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9；p = 0 已验证与改动前的前向逐位一致

note: Dropped by the LETTER of the rule (sps must improve on both splits; the full-split -0.03 sits inside the 0.05 seed floor) and it is the only arm of the six that BEHAVES like a regularizer: training error up 27.6 % while held-out rel-L2 and MVPE improve on both splits. The spectral weights are 99.4 % of an FNO and live on the mode axis, which nothing had ever regularized -- --dropout only touches the channel axis. The cost is TKE, which is what dropping Fourier modes during training should cost: it is a variance-reducing operation and the composed field's amplitude pays. At the sixteen-round weights (rel_l2 0.578 vs tke 0.068) that trade is favourable on paper and wfinal agrees, but sps is the tie-breaker and sps is flat. Follow-up queued at p = 0.10 on top of L8, where the TKE cost should fall faster than the rel-L2 gain.
note_zh: 按规则的字面被淘汰（sps 必须在两个划分上都变好，而全划分的 -0.03 落在 0.05 的种子底噪之内），可它是六个臂里唯一表现得像正则化的：训练误差涨了 27.6 %，而留出集的 rel-L2 与 MVPE 在两个划分上都变好。谱权重占一个 FNO 的 99.4 %，长在模的轴上，而这条轴此前从未被正则化过——--dropout 只作用于通道轴。代价在 TKE，这也正是训练时丢弃 Fourier 模应该付的代价：那是一个降方差的操作，合成场的幅度来买单。在十六轮权重下（rel_l2 0.578 对 tke 0.068）这笔交易纸面上划算，wfinal 也这么说，但决胜项是 sps，而 sps 是平的。后续已排队：在 L8 之上取 p = 0.10，那里 TKE 的代价应当比 rel-L2 的收益掉得更快。

arm: --lam-tail 0.5 (CVaR at 10 % of the per-element field error)
arm_zh: --lam-tail 0.5（逐元素场误差前 10 % 的 CVaR）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched control; compare_v9 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，逐位匹配的对照；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9
effect: WORST arm of the six on every metric and both splits: sps -0.54 proxy / -0.37 full, rel-L2 +0.9 % / +1.1 %, TKE +1.3 % / +0.3 %, MVPE +1.9 % / +1.7 %. The `tail` term converged to 0.3037 and pulled TRAINING field to 0.04006, -15.6 % below the control -- the largest training gain of any 400-epoch arm
effect_zh: 六个臂里最差，每个指标、两个划分都最差：sps 代理集 -0.54 / 全划分 -0.37，rel-L2 +0.9 % / +1.1 %，TKE +1.3 % / +0.3 %，MVPE +1.9 % / +1.7 %。`tail` 项收敛到 0.3037，把训练 field 拉到 0.04006，比对照低 15.6 %——是所有 400 轮实验臂里训练收益最大的一个
note: A CLEAN NEGATIVE FOR THE MECHANISM, NOT FOR THE CODE: the term did exactly what it was asked to and the tail it minimized does not transfer. Round 15's board says the board pays for the error TAIL (T2R3 made rel_l2 0.64 % WORSE and sps +1.013), but the tail that pays is the one you reduce by generalizing better, not the one you can drive down on 74 trajectories. Third time in this project that adding the scorer's own functional to the objective has failed -- --lam-p (the MVPE functional, round 3) and --lam-t upward (the TKE functional, rounds 10-11) are the other two. Do not try a smaller --lam-tail; the axis that moved the board's tail is regularization, and --sam-rho is the version of this idea that does not touch the training residual at all.
note_zh: 这是机制的干净否定，不是代码的：这一项完全做到了要求它做的事，而它压下去的那条尾巴迁移不过去。第 15 轮的 board 说 board 为误差的尾巴买单（T2R3 让 rel_l2 差了 0.64 %，sps 却 +1.013），但真正付钱的那条尾巴，是靠泛化得更好压下来的，不是能在 74 条轨迹上直接压下来的。这是本项目第三次把打分器自身的泛函塞进目标函数而失败——另外两次是 --lam-p（MVPE 泛函，第 3 轮）和把 --lam-t 调高（TKE 泛函，第 10-11 轮）。不要再试更小的 --lam-tail；真正让 board 的尾巴动起来的那条轴是正则化，而 --sam-rho 是这个想法里完全不碰训练残差的版本。

arm_zh: --epochs 800（dropout 0.45 的模型在 400 轮时是否欠训练？）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched control; compare_v9 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，逐位匹配的对照；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9
effect: sps -0.06 proxy / +0.05 full, both INSIDE the three-seed range (0.00 / 0.05); rel-L2 0.1069 / 0.0793 against 0.1065 / 0.0792. Training field 0.04258 @799 vs 0.04746 @399, -10.3 %
note: The do45 model is NOT under-trained at 400 epochs. The premise was reasonable -- 45 % of the channels are zeroed every step, so a do45 model sees fewer effective updates per unit than the do30 model whose 400-epoch schedule it inherited -- and it is wrong: doubling the schedule buys 10.3 % of TRAINING loss and nothing held out. The epoch axis is closed at w96/do45, which also means the 2x wall clock of --sam-rho is NOT recoverable by simply training the control for longer.
note_zh: do45 的模型在 400 轮时并不欠训练。前提本来是合理的——每一步有 45 % 的通道被置零，所以 do45 的模型在同一份 400 轮调度（继承自 do30）下拿到的有效更新更少——但结论是错的：把调度翻倍买到 10.3 % 的训练损失，留出集上什么也没买到。在 w96/do45 上，训练轮数这条轴关闭；这也意味着 --sam-rho 的 2 倍墙钟时间，不可能靠单纯把对照训得更久来补回。

arm: --n-layers 8 at dropout 0.45 (the two best FNO axes of round 15, combined)
arm_zh: dropout 0.45 下的 --n-layers 8（第 15 轮最好的两条 FNO 轴合起来）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched control; compare_v9 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; also against the three round-15 do30_L8 twins
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，逐位匹配的对照；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9；并与第 15 轮的三个 do30_L8 孪生对照
effect: THE ONLY ARM OF SIX TO CLEAR THE DROP RULE: sps 43.97 vs 43.79 proxy (+0.18) and 50.40 vs 50.04 full (+0.36, 7x the three-seed range). Also best rel-L2 (0.1064 / 0.0789), best TKE (0.4929 vs 0.5041, -2.2 %; 0.5070 vs 0.5158, -1.7 %) and best MVPE on both splits; wfinal +0.070 / +0.110. Training field 0.03837, -19.2 %, but WITH a held-out gain. Against do30_L8 x3 it wins rel-L2 on both splits (-1.1 % / -0.8 %) and ties on full-split sps and TKE
effect_zh: 六个臂里唯一通过淘汰规则的：sps 代理集 43.97 对 43.79（+0.18），全划分 50.40 对 50.04（+0.36，是三种子极差的 7 倍）。rel-L2（0.1064 / 0.0789）、TKE（0.4929 对 0.5041，-2.2 %；0.5070 对 0.5158，-1.7 %）与 MVPE 在两个划分上也都是最好；wfinal +0.070 / +0.110。训练 field 0.03837，-19.2 %，但伴随留出集的收益。对上 do30_L8 x3，它在两个划分上都赢 rel-L2（-1.1 % / -0.8 %），全划分 sps 与 TKE 打平
note: Depth generalizes where width did not, and dropout 0.45 at depth 8 buys rel-L2 and nothing else -- which at the sixteen-round weights (rel_l2 0.578, tke 0.068) is the favourable half of the trade. ONE SEED IS NOT A MEASUREMENT (ROADMAP 1.15: every per-model gain since round 10 has shrunk or reversed at ensemble size, because most were variance reductions and ensembling already reduces variance), so this stays OPEN until the Q4 3-vs-3 lands: seeds 2-3 are training as rp_q4a 7153910, against do45 L4 x3, do30_L8 x3, w96 do30 x3 and the w24 do05 anchor, on both splits. Gate: +0.3 sps or 1 % rel-L2 at 3-vs-3. Four speculative all-data members are training in parallel as rp_q5a 7153911 so the slot is not lost if the gate passes. Caveat: the do45-vs-do30 delta at depth 8 is ~1 % of rel-L2, at or under the board's ~4 % transfer resolution.
note_zh: 深度在宽度失败的地方泛化住了，而深度 8 下的 dropout 0.45 只买到 rel-L2、别的什么也没买——在十六轮权重下（rel_l2 0.578，tke 0.068）这正是这笔交易划算的那一半。单个种子不算测量（ROADMAP 1.15：自第 10 轮起，每一个单模型收益在集成规模上都缩水或反号，因为它们多半是降方差，而集成本身已经在降方差），所以在 Q4 的 3 对 3 出来之前它保持未决：种子 2-3 正作为 rp_q4a 7153910 训练，对手是 do45 L4 x3、do30_L8 x3、w96 do30 x3 以及 w24 do05 这个锚，两个划分都跑。闸门：3 对 3 上 +0.3 sps 或 1 % rel-L2。四个试探性的全量成员正作为 rp_q5a 7153911 并行训练，这样闸门一旦通过就不会浪费提交位。告诫：深度 8 下 do45 与 do30 的差距约是 rel-L2 的 1 %，恰好在或低于 board 约 4 % 的迁移分辨率。

arm: --n-layers 8 at dropout 0.45: seeds 2-3 and the five-set 3-vs-3
arm_zh: dropout 0.45 下的 --n-layers 8：种子 2-3 与五组 3 对 3
instrument: three seeds per set, ens_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --f 1.39 at 3-vs-3 on the AoA 15-20 proxy AND the full split, five seed-matched triples (do45_L8, do45 L4, do30_L8, w96 do30, w24 do05); per-model compare_v9 first
instrument_zh: 每组三个种子，ens_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --f 1.39 做 3 对 3，AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分都跑，五组种子匹配的三元组（do45_L8、do45 L4、do30_L8、w96 do30、w24 do05）；先出逐模型的 compare_v9 表
effect: The three L8 do45 seeds replicate to the seed floor: proxy sps 43.97 / 43.96 / 44.00 (range 0.04), full-split 50.40 / 50.43 / 50.41 (range 0.03), each beating the bit-matched L4 control on sps on both splits. At 3-vs-3 the full-split sps ladder reads w24 do05 42.79 -> w96 do30 43.72 -> do45 L4 43.64 -> do30_L8 43.98 = do45_L8 43.98. DEPTH is +0.34 sps at do45 and +0.26 at do30, rel-L2 -0.52 % at both; DROPOUT 0.30 -> 0.45 AT DEPTH 8 is +0.00 sps and -0.52 % rel-L2 (proxy: +0.13 sps)
effect_zh: 三个 L8 do45 种子复制到种子底噪：代理集 sps 43.97 / 43.96 / 44.00（极差 0.04），全划分 50.40 / 50.43 / 50.41（极差 0.03），每一个在两个划分上都赢逐位匹配的 L4 对照。3 对 3 的全划分 sps 阶梯为 w24 do05 42.79 -> w96 do30 43.72 -> do45 L4 43.64 -> do30_L8 43.98 = do45_L8 43.98。深度在 do45 上值 +0.34 sps、在 do30 上值 +0.26，两者 rel-L2 都是 -0.52 %；而深度 8 下把 dropout 从 0.30 提到 0.45 是 +0.00 sps、-0.52 % rel-L2（代理集 +0.13 sps）
note: THE GAIN BARELY SHRINKS AT ENSEMBLE SIZE, which is unusual here and is the reason the gate is read as a pass. Per model the full-split sps margin was +0.36...+0.39; at 3-vs-3 it is +0.34. ROADMAP 1.15's failure mode is a per-model gain that evaporates because it was a variance reduction the ensemble average already supplies -- this one does not evaporate, and the same depth effect appears independently at the other dropout level (+0.26 at do30, same -0.52 % rel-L2). Strictly the plan's gate (>= +0.3 sps or >= 1 % rel-L2 at 3-vs-3, against do45 x3) passes on exactly one of its four cells, by 0.04. THE DECOMPOSITION IS THE RESULT: depth pays, the extra dropout at depth does not. That makes rp_q5a's four all-data do45 L8 members an EQUAL package, not an upgrade -- so the slot pair becomes Track 2 = do30 L8x4 vs T2R3 and Track 1 = do45 L8x4 vs R16, which is the first board reading of the dropout-at-depth axis on a change that is locally exactly null. What Q5's k-fold confirmation should test is DEPTH, not dropout.
note_zh: 在集成规模上收益几乎没有缩水，这在本项目里很少见，也正是把闸门读成通过的理由。逐模型的全划分 sps 优势是 +0.36...+0.39；到 3 对 3 仍有 +0.34。ROADMAP 1.15 描述的失效模式是：单模型收益本质是降方差，而集成平均本来就在降方差，于是收益蒸发——这一次没有蒸发，而且同样的深度效应在另一个 dropout 水平上独立出现（do30 上 +0.26，rel-L2 同样 -0.52 %）。严格按计划的闸门（3 对 3 上相对 do45 x3 达到 +0.3 sps 或 1 % rel-L2），四个格子里只过了一个，还只多 0.04。真正的结论是这个分解：深度买单，深度之上的额外 dropout 不买单。这让 rp_q5a 的四个 all-data do45 L8 成员成为一个等价的包、而不是升级——于是提交位配成 Track 2 = do30 L8x4 对 T2R3、Track 1 = do45 L8x4 对 R16，这是对 dropout-at-depth 这条轴的第一次 board 读数，而它在本地恰好为零。Q5 的 k-fold 确认该测的是深度，不是 dropout。

arm: the interior Re-band k-fold on U-FNO -- the round's method question
arm_zh: 在 U-FNO 上跑内部雷诺数分带 k-fold——本轮的方法学问题
instrument: kfold.py --split re, five folds of the U-FNO recipe paired fold-for-fold against the round-15 kfre_w96do30_f0..4 FNOs; decision on interior bands 1-3 (2152 windows / 52 trajectories), all five bands reported
instrument_zh: kfold.py --split re，U-FNO 配方的五折，与第 15 轮的 kfre_w96do30_f0..4 逐折配对；判据取内部第 1-3 带（2152 个窗口 / 52 条轨迹），五个带全部报告
effect: Interior bands 1-3, paired: rel-L2 -2.14 % (z -6.86), TKE -3.13 % (z -12.15), MVPE -1.10 %, sps +0.92 -- against the AoA 15-20 proxy's -3.0 % / +1.10 and the BOARD's +1.90 % (WORSE) / +0.44. Monotone in Reynolds band: 0 -18.2 %, 1 -3.8 %, 2 -2.2 %, 3 -0.4 %, 4 +1.3 % (worse)
note: IT REPRODUCED THE PROXY, NOT THE BOARD -- the pre-registered second branch. Two thirds of the proxy's gain, and the WRONG SIGN against the board on the subscore carrying 0.578 of the weight. So the k-fold is NOT confirmed as a cross-family gate: what rounds 14-15 established is that it transfers INSIDE the FNO family (dropout and w96 x dropout both went k-fold -> board within ~0.3 pp), and on a change of architecture family it fails the same way the AoA proxy did, only slightly less. NEITHER LOCAL INSTRUMENT WE OWN CAN RANK TWO ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES, now measured twice on the same candidate. U-FNO, ViT, AFNO and the cross-family trio stay closed -- not because a better instrument rejected them, but because nothing we own predicts a cross-family board delta, and U-FNO's own board round priced the family at -0.45 (+0.07 at matched latency, inside noise). What the k-fold DOES show is that U-FNO's advantage decays monotonically as the band moves INTO distribution and reverses at the top (+1.3 %), which is the shape of an out-of-distribution robustness effect and is consistent with the board seeing none of it; band 0 is exactly the regime round 14 retired (phi = 0). Caveat: one seed per fold per family, and the board ran 3 U-FNO against 8 FNO members -- so the honest statement is 'the k-fold did not catch what the proxy missed', not 'the k-fold is wrong by 4 pp'.
note_zh: 它复现的是代理集，不是 board——正是预先登记的第二个分支。它拿到代理集收益的三分之二，而在权重占 0.578 的那个子分数上，与 board 的符号相反。所以 k-fold 没有被确认为跨家族的闸门：第 14-15 轮真正确立的是它在 FNO 家族内部会迁移（dropout 与 w96 x dropout 都做到 k-fold -> board 相差约 0.3 pp），一旦换了架构家族，它就和 AoA 代理集一样失效，只是稍好一点。我们手上没有任何本地工具能给两个架构家族排序，这一点如今已在同一个候选上量到两次。U-FNO、ViT、AFNO 与跨家族三人组仍然关闭——不是因为有更好的工具否决了它们，而是因为我们没有任何工具能预测跨家族的 board 变化，而 U-FNO 自己的 board 轮次已经给这个家族定价为 -0.45（延迟对齐后 +0.07，落在噪声内）。k-fold 确实显示出的是：U-FNO 的优势随分带越进入分布而单调衰减，并在最高带反号（+1.3 %），这正是分布外鲁棒性效应的形状，也与 board 完全看不到它相符；第 0 带恰好是第 14 轮已退役的那个区间（phi = 0）。告诫：每个家族每折只有一个种子，且 board 上是 3 个 U-FNO 对 8 个 FNO 成员——所以诚实的说法是「k-fold 没能抓住代理集漏掉的东西」，而不是「k-fold 错了 4 pp」。

arm: D1: the zero-set / boundary hypothesis for U-FNO's board miss
arm_zh: D1：把 U-FNO 的 board 落空归因于零集 / 边界的假设
instrument: Track_1/diag_boundary.py on the 336 val_unseen windows, ALPHA 0.60 composition in raw physical units, three 3-member HELD-OUT ensembles (U-FNO, w96 do30, w96 L8 do45); chessboard distance bands to the per-window zero set, plus AoA and domain-half cuts
instrument_zh: Track_1/diag_boundary.py 跑 336 个 val_unseen 窗口，ALPHA 0.60 合成、原始物理单位，三个 3 成员的留出集成（U-FNO、w96 do30、w96 L8 do45）；按到逐窗口零集的棋盘距离分带，另加迎角与流向半域切分
effect: Pre-registered reading was 'boundary-localized iff >= 40 % of the squared-error REDUCTION falls within d <= 3'. Measured: d <= 3 holds 19.27 % of elements and 13.64 % of the control's squared error but only +1.77 % of U-FNO's reduction, against +99.4 % at d > 12. The decisive cut is the domain half: +101.95 % of the reduction sits in the AFT half x >= 32, whose zero-set fraction is 0.00 %, while the fore half (all 15.49 % of the zero set) is +0.06 % WORSE. corr(gain, Z fraction) = -0.196; U-FNO is worst at AoA 0 (+1.10 %), the angle with the most zero set. The within-family L8 do45 change is 8x more boundary-active (13.62 % of its reduction at d <= 3)
effect_zh: 预先登记的判读是「若平方误差降低量有 >= 40 % 落在 d <= 3 内，则为边界局部化」。实测：d <= 3 占 19.27 % 的元素、占对照平方误差的 13.64 %，却只占 U-FNO 降低量的 +1.77 %，而 d > 12 一档就占 +99.4 %。决定性的切分是流向半域：+101.95 % 的降低量落在后半域 x >= 32，而那里零集占比为 0.00 %；前半域（全部 15.49 % 的零集都在那里）反而 +0.06 % 更差。corr(收益, 零集占比) = -0.196；U-FNO 在 AoA 0 上最差（+1.10 %），而那正是零集最多的迎角。家族内部的 L8 do45 改动的边界活跃度是它的 8 倍（降低量的 13.62 % 落在 d <= 3）
note: THE HYPOTHESIS IS REFUTED, at 1.8 % against a pre-registered 40 %. Round 15's own argument for U-FNO was that 'mode truncation cannot represent the sharp zero set of the PIV field of view and the airfoil body' -- if the gain lived there, a hidden set with a different zero set would erase it, which would have explained the T2R4 miss. It does not live there: U-FNO's advantage is a FAR-FIELD WAKE effect, more than 12 pixels from any zero element, in the half of the domain the mask never touches. A hidden test set with a different FOV / airfoil geometry therefore cannot explain the board miss. The remaining candidates are the wake statistics themselves (PIV processing, seeding, interrogation-window size, shedding regime) or plain in-distribution memorization of the 74 training wakes -- which a local conv stack can do and a mode-truncated spectral operator structurally cannot. That makes the miss a STATISTICAL problem, not a geometric one, and it supports plan 2's decision to stay inside the FNO family. Side effect: it removes --aug-mask's stated motivation before that arm was even scored. Also worth keeping: the zero set is 7.74 % of PIXELS on val_unseen (9.26 % of u,v elements), not CLAUDE.md round 14's 3.3 %, which counts something else; and both families emit only 3-5e-4 m/s inside it, 0.01-0.02 % of the total squared error.
note_zh: 假设被否证，1.8 % 对预先登记的 40 %。第 15 轮为 U-FNO 辩护的理由本是「模态截断表示不了 PIV 视场与翼型本体那种锐利的零集」——如果收益真在那里，换一个零集的隐藏测试集就会把它抹掉，那样 T2R4 的落空就有解释了。可它不在那里：U-FNO 的优势是远场尾迹效应，距离任何零元素都超过 12 个像素，位于掩码根本不碰的那半个域。因此，视场 / 翼型几何不同的隐藏测试集，无法解释 board 上的落空。剩下的候选只有尾迹统计本身（PIV 处理、播撒密度、询问窗大小、脱涡状态），或者干脆就是对 74 条训练轨迹尾迹的分布内记忆——后者局部卷积栈做得到，而模态截断的谱算子在结构上做不到。这把落空变成一个统计问题而非几何问题，也支持计划第 2 节留在 FNO 家族内的决定。副作用：它在 --aug-mask 还没被打分之前，就取消了那个实验臂的立论。另有两点值得留存：val_unseen 上零集占像素的 7.74 %（占 u,v 元素的 9.26 %），而不是 CLAUDE.md 第 14 轮记的 3.3 %——那是另一种计数；两个家族在零集内都只吐出 3-5e-4 m/s，占总平方误差的 0.01-0.02 %。

arm_zh: --sam-rho 0.05（Sharpness-Aware Minimization：偏好平坦极小点）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_cap_w96_do45_e400; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_cap_w96_do45_e400 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39
effect: sps 43.69 vs 43.79 proxy (-0.10) and 49.95 vs 50.04 full (-0.09): fails the drop rule on both. rel-L2 +0.19 % / -0.13 %, TKE -0.02 % / 0.00 %, MVPE +0.10 % / -0.71 %; wfinal 82.160 / 84.357 against 82.188 / 84.376. Training field 0.05037 vs 0.04746, +6.1 % (fits worse, no held-out gain). ~2x wall clock: 5285 s against ~4700 s
note: SAM WAS THE OTHER SIDE OF THE TAIL IDEA, and it fails too. Round 15's board says what is paid for is the per-element error TAIL, not the rms (w96 x dropout made rel_l2 0.64 % WORSE and sps +1.013). Q2b's --lam-tail wrote that tail straight into the objective and was the worst arm of six -- the third time the scorer's own functional in the loss has memorized instead of generalized. SAM does not reweight the training error at all: it takes the gradient at the worst point of a rho-ball around the current weights, so the optimizer prefers a flat minimum, and flatness is a property of the loss SURFACE rather than of the training residual. It does exactly that -- the training loss visibly refuses to come down -- and the flatter minimum does not generalize better here. See the rho = 0.10 arm for the monotone half of the result. TOGETHER THE TWO ARMS CLOSE THE TAIL-THROUGH-OPTIMIZATION IDEA FROM BOTH SIDES; the only mechanism that has ever moved the board's tail remains plain regularization (dropout, depth).
note_zh: SAM 是「尾巴」这个想法的另一面，它同样失败。第 15 轮的 board 说买单的是逐元素误差的尾巴，不是 rms（w96 x dropout 让 rel_l2 差了 0.64 %，sps 却 +1.013）。Q2b 的 --lam-tail 把那条尾巴直接写进目标函数，成了六个臂里最差的一个——这是把打分器自身的泛函塞进损失、结果只学会记忆而非泛化的第三次。SAM 完全不重新加权训练误差：它在当前权重周围一个 rho 球的最差点上取梯度，于是优化器偏好平坦极小点，而平坦是损失曲面的性质、不是训练残差的性质。它确实做到了这一点——训练损失明显下不去——但这个更平坦的极小点在这里并没有泛化得更好。单调的另一半见 rho = 0.10 那个臂。两个臂合起来，把「靠优化去压尾巴」这个想法从两侧都封死了；唯一真正让 board 的尾巴动过的机制，仍然只有朴素的正则化（dropout、深度）。

arm_zh: --sam-rho 0.10（同一机制，强度再上一档）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched control; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on both splits; read together with the rho = 0.05 arm as a two-point sweep
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，逐位匹配的对照；两个划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；与 rho = 0.05 那个臂合起来读作一次两点扫描
effect: sps 43.63 vs 43.79 proxy (-0.16) and 49.90 vs 50.04 full (-0.14) -- WORSE than rho = 0.05 on both, i.e. MONOTONE in rho. rel-L2 +0.47 % / 0.00 %, TKE -0.34 % / +0.04 %, MVPE -0.41 % / -0.71 %; wfinal 82.142 / 84.342. Training field 0.05253, +10.7 % over the control and +4.3 % over rho = 0.05
note: THE MONOTONICITY IS WHAT CLOSES THE AXIS. Two rho a decade apart in the usual range, both bit-matched to the same control, and sps falls further with more SAM on BOTH splits while the training loss rises further -- that is a clean dose-response in the wrong direction, not a seed draw (the floor is 0.00-0.05 sps). No smaller rho is worth an arm: the curve points away from the control, so the limit of the family is the control itself. The ~2x wall clock is also not recoverable by simply training the control longer -- Q2b's --epochs 800 already showed the do45 model is NOT under-trained at 400 (+10.3 % of training loss, nothing held out).
note_zh: 真正关掉这条轴的是它的单调性。两个 rho 在常用范围内相差一个数量级，都与同一个对照逐位匹配，而 SAM 越强，两个划分上的 sps 就掉得越多、训练损失也升得越高——这是一条方向错误但干净的剂量-反应曲线，不是种子抽样（底噪是 0.00-0.05 sps）。更小的 rho 不值得再花一个臂：曲线是朝着背离对照的方向走的，所以这一族的极限就是对照本身。约 2 倍的墙钟也无法靠把对照训得更久来补回——Q2b 的 --epochs 800 已经证明 do45 模型在 400 轮时并不欠训练（训练损失 +10.3 %，留出集毫无所得）。

arm_zh: 在 --n-layers 8 之上的 --mode-drop 0.10（md20 的更轻量后续）

instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，既对上 L8 现任 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8（它真正的对照），也对上 L4 对照；两个划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39

Training field 0.04478 vs 0.03837, +16.7 %. vs the L4 control it is +0.27 sps on both splits, but that credit belongs to DEPTH
effect_zh: 对上 L8 现任：sps 代理集 +0.09、全划分 -0.09——一个分裂的判决，两格都高于 0.03-0.05 的种子底噪却方向相反，所以没过规则。rel-L2 -0.94 % / -0.51 %（本轮表里最好），TKE +0.93 % / +0.32 %，MVPE -0.52 % / +0.14 %；wfinal 82.293（本轮代理集最好）/ 84.470。训练 field 0.04478 对 0.03837，+16.7 %。对上 L4 对照则是两个划分各 +0.27 sps，但那份功劳属于深度
note: THE PRE-REGISTERED HYPOTHESIS IS FALSIFIED AND THE SHAPE REPLICATES EXACTLY. The plan said halving p from 0.20 to 0.10 should shrink the TKE cost faster than the rel-L2 gain. It did the opposite: the TKE cost did NOT fall (md20 on L4 was +0.8 % / +0.5 %; md10 on L8 is +0.93 % / +0.32 %) while the rel-L2 gain DID (md20 -1.3 % / -1.0 %; md10 -0.94 % / -0.51 %). What replicates is the signature: two p values, two depths, two comparators, and every time the best rel-L2 in the table, a TKE cost, and sps flat. --mode-drop IS a real regularizer -- the only axis that touches the MODE dimension, where 99.4 % of an FNO's parameters live, and it fits the training set 16.7 % worse while improving held-out rel-L2 -- and at the sixteen-round weights (rel_l2 0.578 vs tke 0.068) its trade is favourable on paper, which is why wfinal picks it on the proxy. But sps is the tie-breaker and sps will not move, twice now. Do not spend a third arm on p; reopening the axis needs a different question (mode-drop with the TKE term reweighted, or on all-data members where the ensemble may absorb the TKE cost), not another p.
note_zh: 预先登记的假设被证伪，而效应的形状精确重现。计划说把 p 从 0.20 减半到 0.10，TKE 的代价应该比 rel-L2 的收益掉得更快。结果恰好相反：TKE 的代价没有下降（L4 上的 md20 是 +0.8 % / +0.5 %，L8 上的 md10 是 +0.93 % / +0.32 %），而 rel-L2 的收益反倒缩水了（md20 -1.3 % / -1.0 %，md10 -0.94 % / -0.51 %）。真正重现的是那个特征：两个 p、两个深度、两个对照，每一次都是表里最好的 rel-L2、一份 TKE 代价、以及纹丝不动的 sps。--mode-drop 确实是个真正的正则化——它是唯一作用在模这个维度上的轴，而 FNO 99.4 % 的参数就长在那里；它让训练集拟合差了 16.7 %，留出集的 rel-L2 却变好——在十六轮权重下（rel_l2 0.578 对 tke 0.068）这笔交易纸面上划算，wfinal 在代理集上也确实选它。但决胜项是 sps，而 sps 已经两次纹丝不动。不要为 p 再花第三个臂；要重开这条轴，需要换一个问题（把 TKE 项重新加权后的 mode-drop，或者放到 all-data 成员上、让集成去吸收 TKE 的代价），而不是换一个 p。

arm_zh: 在匹配优化步数下的 --phases 4（--epochs 100），在深度 8 / dropout 0.45 上重问

instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；100 轮 x 1505 步 = 150,500 个优化步，对照是 400 x 376 = 150,400，所以唯一的差别就是 4 倍的真实窗口（48,160 对 12,040）
effect: sps +0.05 proxy / +0.02 full -- the full-split margin is INSIDE the 0.05 seed floor, so it fails the drop rule on the 'both splits' clause. It is not a null though: rel-L2 -0.38 % / -0.51 % and MVPE -0.41 % / -0.71 %, four numbers with the same sign on two splits, against a TKE cost of +0.89 % / +0.63 %. Training field 0.03895 vs 0.03837 (+1.5 %), and training var 0.30868 -> 0.32780, +6.2 %, the largest var regression of the round
effect_zh: sps 代理集 +0.05、全划分 +0.02——全划分这一格落在 0.05 的种子底噪之内，所以在「两个划分」这一条上没过淘汰规则。但它不是零结果：rel-L2 -0.38 % / -0.51 %，MVPE -0.41 % / -0.71 %，四个数在两个划分上同号，代价是 TKE +0.89 % / +0.63 %。训练 field 0.03895 对 0.03837（+1.5 %），训练 var 从 0.30868 升到 0.32780，+6.2 %，是本轮最大的 var 退步
note: A REPLICATION, AND IT MUST BE READ AS ONE. Round 15 already ran --phases 4 at matched optimizer steps and rejected it (proxy 82.111 / full 84.321, both inside the w96 do30 seed spread) -- but at w96/do30/L4. This is w96/do45/L8, so the two are one experiment at two operating points, and they agree: sps flat, inside the floor, twice. Round 15's explanation, 'the three extra decimation phases are correlated views, not independent data', survives the test at depth. TWO THINGS ARE WORTH KEEPING. (1) The training-curve screen called it before the scoring did: var is a mean squared log error against std_t(y), the very quantity sigma is judged on, so an arm that moves var the WRONG way by 6.2 % cannot improve TKE -- and held-out TKE duly got worse on both splits. Read the curve first; it costs nothing and it is right. (2) The signature -- best rel-L2 in the table, a TKE cost, sps flat -- is EXACTLY --mode-drop's from round 16, from a completely unrelated mechanism (more data rather than fewer retained modes). Two unrelated regularizers producing one signature is evidence about the OPERATING POINT, not about either mechanism: at w96/L8/do45 a rel-L2 <-> TKE exchange is available in several directions and sps sits at a stationary point along all of them. note: ROUND 11'S LESSON, RE-APPLIED TO THE LINE NEXT DOOR. Round 11 found the SPS band stage was 1.45 ms/window of avoidable memory traffic because numpy's ufuncs are single-threaded and the work is bandwidth-bound, and moved it to torch -- and never looked at the output write three lines above it, which had the identical disease. The coordinator's proposed repair was different and the probe rejected it: writing a contiguous (N,20,32,64,2) buffer and assembling the 3-channel array once is a WASH (+0.011 ms/window), because the assembly is itself a strided write of the same bytes and gives back everything the contiguous per-batch write saved. Pinned + asynchronous D2H is also ~0 (+0.006): the transfer is 21 MB/batch already running at 26 GB/s pinned, so there is nothing to overlap. The write was never slow because it was strided; it was slow because it was single-threaded. TWO THINGS THIS OPENS. (1) The profile says the GPU is busy only 63 % of a batch (self CUDA 58.99 ms against 93.4 ms of real batch-64 time) with 279 kernel launches per batch, so the host half is not a rounding error -- it is 0.68 ms/window that no model change, no precision and no capacity decision can touch. (2) The band stage is now the largest remaining host item at 0.216 ms/window, still only 6.8 GB/s after round 11 threaded it, because it materialises lower and upper as two full 165 MB arrays. Separately: RPDE_SPEC=bmm, built in the same commit, is SLOWER on Track 1 (+1.6 % / +2.4 %) because the spectral einsum is not even in Track 1's top-15 kernels, but it is -16.6 % on the Track-2 graph step, where the profile shows einsum's strided WEIGHT copy ([4,8,12,96,1,96], 16 calls) eating 27.6 % of the step -- one switch, opposite signs on the two tracks, and the reason is batch size.
note_zh: 第 11 轮的教训，被重新用在了隔壁那一行上。第 11 轮发现 SPS 的 band 阶段有每窗口 1.45 毫秒的可避免内存流量，原因是 numpy 的 ufunc 是单线程的而这活儿受带宽限制，于是把它挪到了 torch——却从没看过上面三行的那个输出写，而它得的是一模一样的病。协调者提出的修法是另一个，探针否决了它：写一个连续的 (N,20,32,64,2) 缓冲、最后一次性组装出 3 通道数组，是一次白忙（每窗口 +0.011 毫秒），因为那次组装本身就是同样字节数的跨步写，把连续分批写省下的又还了回去。锁页 + 异步 D2H 同样约等于零（+0.006）：传输只有每批 21 MB，锁页后已经跑在 26 GB/s，根本没有东西可以重叠。这个写从来不是因为跨步才慢，是因为单线程才慢。它打开了两件事。(1) profile 说 GPU 在一个批里只忙了 63 %（自 CUDA 时间 58.99 毫秒，对上批-64 的真实 93.4 毫秒），每批有 279 次核函数启动，所以主机那一半不是舍入误差——它是每窗口 0.68 毫秒，任何模型改动、任何精度、任何容量决策都碰不到。(2) band 阶段现在是剩下最大的主机项，每窗口 0.216 毫秒，在第 11 轮把它多线程化之后仍然只有 6.8 GB/s，因为它把 lower 和 upper 各自实体化成一个完整的 165 MB 数组。另外：同一个提交里做的 RPDE_SPEC=bmm 在 Track 1 上更慢（+1.6 % / +2.4 %），因为谱域 einsum 根本没进 Track 1 的前 15 个核函数；但它在 Track 2 的 graph 步上是 -16.6 %，那里 profile 显示 einsum 对跨步权重的拷贝（[4,8,12,96,1,96]，16 次调用）吃掉了整步的 27.6 %——同一个开关，在两条赛道上符号相反，原因是批大小。
